en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Even less green than last time.
There's still maintenance going on.

So what's the deal with this place anyway!?
What kinda facility was it before!?

Are they renovating an old facility?
Perhaps constructing a new building...?

At the start, Monokuma said they were
supposed to be <CLT=cltSTRONG>facilities for us<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That's obviously a lie! That plush bear is
stuffed with lies and shit!

It is hard to imagine that they built this
entire facility just for us.

I also think Monokuma was lying. He is an
exceptionally deceitful being.
"Being"? Well, he's a robot, isn't he?

...Shuichi, have you been a robophobe this
whole time?
Ah, no, that's not what I meant...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...when will we finally learn what
this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy<CLT=cltMIND> really is?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is it really just a place for us to
have the killing game?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
